summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase its at-the-market (ATM) offering by up to $4.25 million of common stock via H.C. Wainwright and co-agents. The filing updates prior supplements under an existing S-3 registration; total prior sales were $10.7 million. Shares trade on Nasdaq (symbol USGO); last price $8.84. The offering is a routine capital raise through an ATM facility, not a distressed or transformative special situation. There is no premium, recommendation, or structural complexity; watch for dilution risk from continued ATM sales.
